essence: Qualification depends on the specific kind of fruit and the context in which that fruit appears.
Eligibility is shaped by both the practitioner's embodied condition and their received preparation.
The order of qualification for teacher and student follows the same logic of preparatory fitness as other regulated procedures.
Purification must come before initiation so that disruptive change does not interfere with subsequent ritual performance.
Because their conditioning belongs to the paśu level, Vaishnavas and others are not qualified for those rites.
